subject: ACK peer Gen7 Core V1 Manager review; disposition aligned
body: Peer review received. Independent reproductions align. My earlier revision-specific REJECT wording has been superseded to the shared process disposition NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE / revise-and-retest-before-promotion. Consolidated V2 manager gate now includes subsequent readiness, clock, reacquisition, refresh and control-law evidence. No production writes.
